biography: Cody Ware's journey to the asphalt oval began not on a go-kart track, but behind the wheel of a beat-up pickup truck on his family's sprawling ranch in rural Texas. From a young age, Cody displayed a knack for speed and a fearlessness that bordered on reckless. Weekends were spent tearing through dusty fields, honing his car control and developing a taste for adrenaline. His entry into organized racing was almost accidental. While accompanying a friend to a local dirt track event, Cody impulsively entered a last-minute race and, despite driving a borrowed, ill-equipped vehicle, managed to secure a surprising second-place finish. This ignited a passion that couldn't be extinguished. He quickly climbed the racing ladder, showcasing his raw talent and aggressive driving style, eventually attracting the attention of Stock USA Gen3. Though victories have been elusive so far, Cody's undeniable charisma and willingness to push the limits have made him a fan favorite, promising a bright future in the sport.
drivingStyle: Cody's driving style is best described as aggressive and opportunistic. He's not afraid to make daring moves, often diving into tight gaps and pushing his car to the absolute limit. While this approach sometimes leads to spectacular overtakes, it also results in costly mistakes and damaged equipment. He thrives in high-pressure situations, exhibiting a remarkable ability to stay calm and focused when the stakes are high. However, his tire management could use improvement, as he tends to burn through his rubber early in races, sacrificing late-race pace for initial gains.

rivalries.reason: A bitter rivalry stemming from a controversial late-race collision that cost Cody a potential podium finish. The bad blood continues to simmer both on and off the track.
A clash of styles. Ricardo, known for his calculated precision, often criticizes Cody's 'reckless' maneuvers, leading to heated exchanges and intense on-track battles.
A rivalry sparked by Cody's off-track comments regarding Ashley's skill level. Ashley uses Cody's opinions as fuel to prove him wrong.

quirks: Always wears a pair of lucky socks, gifted to him by his grandmother, for every race.
Listens to a specific heavy metal song on repeat for 30 minutes before getting into the car.
Insists on having a single green apple in his pit box for good luck.
famousQuote: "I don't race to finish second. I race to win, and if that means pushing the limits, so be it."
careerHighlight: Winning the Stock USA Gen3 Rookie of the Year award after a season filled with impressive performances and memorable battles.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the championship race while leading in the final laps, costing him a potential title victory.
